blocks.title: Bell wing · pendulum, vespers, saint — three more surfaces in the chamber
blocks.dek: Mike: 'ok keep going, run over next hour' on Monday afternoon. Three new bell-wing surfaces shipped in the same afternoon — a swinging pendulum, automatic hourly vespers, and a per-visitor patron noun. The chamber now has eight surfaces, five on the altar bus and three meditative bell variants.
